title: Deeper/broader cross-project carrier, loss, and reader-safety review
scope: Refresh Autodesk DXF modeler-geometry wrapper requirements relevant to SAT text and binary carrier handling
Review LibreDWG release security and writer fixes as failure-class evidence without attributing peer defects locally
Refresh the current status and implementation boundaries of ACadSharp ACIS writer proposals
Reconcile recent peer loss and consumer reports with existing libdxfrw AcDs, graph, bounded-decode, and semantic-support owners

method.kind: Read-only review of official format documentation and public primary-source project releases, issues, pull requests, and local plan/source inventory
method.limitations: Issue reports and pull-request comments are implementation- and revision-specific evidence, not normative rules or local reproductions. ACadSharp #1282 and #1283 were seen only in the current issue index; their full bodies were not retrieved. No peer artifact was pinned and executed.

sources.observed: The DXF wrapper identifies AcDbModelerGeometry, group 70, proprietary group 1 strings and optional group 3 continuation strings, then AcDb3dSolid and group 350 history reference. It does not define DWG AcDs byte layout or ACIS semantic validity.

sources.revision: official DXF group-code reference page reviewed 2026-10-17
sources.observed: The general code table distinguishes 310-319 binary chunks and 330-369 pointer/ownership categories; these wire roles must not be conflated with group-1/3 SAT text or group-350 history handles.

sources.revision: mutable master NEWS page, 0.14.1 entry dated 2026-07-25, reviewed 2026-10-17
sources.observed: The release notes describe peer fixes for compressed-section range and multiplication overflow, live buffer capacity drift, stale object pointers across reallocation, oversized SAT-block bounds, non-finite writer-loop hangs, and a dropped final SAT block. These are risk classes, not evidence of matching libdxfrw defects.

sources.revision: open issue reviewed 2026-10-17; report pins peer build 0.14.8593 at commit prefix 8a1ae764
sources.observed: The issue provides a scratch-authored AC1032 DXF-to-DWG-to-DXF case where a REGION shell remains but its 5,489-byte SAB body and AcDs records disappear; a separate confidential R2018 report is not reproducible. The issue does not establish current-master behavior or libdxfrw behavior.

sources.revision: open issue reviewed 2026-10-17; reports LibreDWG 0.14 and master
sources.observed: The reporter says the peer CMC reader reconstructs a palette index from RGB, collapsing distinct ACI values that share one RGB value. This motivates a conditional source-index preservation vector in the local color/down-conversion owner; it is not a local defect.

sources.revision: issue page reviewed 2026-10-17; reporter says fixed on peer master after R2007 decode changes
sources.observed: Historical unresolvable-owner traversal loss reportedly disappeared on peer master for three AC1021 cases after decoder changes. It is not a current peer failure or a local regression; plan already distinguishes traversal termination from decode failure.

sources.revision: open issue page reviewed 2026-10-17; report names NuGet 3.4.9
sources.observed: The report describes silent omission of 3DSOLID/REGION from DWG-to-DXF output, including solids inside blocks; peer entity counts and empty-block effects are not a local reproduction.

sources.revision: open, undeployed PR reviewed 2026-10-17; latest visible comments Oct. 1, 2026
sources.observed: The proposed writer separates pre-2013 SAT text from modern SAB/AcDs storage, reports an out-of-order handle-index correction, and describes self-reported TrueView checks. Later comments say the branch conflicts with the refactored reader and that the current DXF reader retained only the last repeated 310 chunk; the maintainer prefers schema-driven storage reconstruction. No released capability is established.
The maintainer's ACIS writer proposal remains separate from released behavior and depends on the ACDS/ACIS schema refactor; its status does not establish a current comparator pass.

sources.revision: open issue reviewed 2026-10-17; report names ACadSharp 3.8.0 and AC1014 input
sources.observed: The issue repeats the already-mapped malformed/underspecified child VERTEX subtype-marker failure shape; it does not establish the validity of every missing-marker form.

sources.revision: open issue reviewed 2026-10-17; report names AC1032 and AutoCAD 2025 Core Console
sources.observed: A reporter says an MTEXT with only a text-frame flag is rejected while a combined flag opens; the cause was not isolated, and visual-style absence was only a hypothesis.

sources.revision: open issue reviewed 2026-10-17; report names ACadSharp 3.8.0 and downstream GDAL conversion
sources.observed: The reporter says a DWG-to-DXF conversion produced spline data rejected by GDAL; the issue body provides no established root cause. Treat as a peer compatibility lead, not a local defect or DXF rule.

sources.revision: worktree plan over baseline de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9 reviewed 2026-10-17
sources.observed: All findings map to existing AcDs/ACIS carrier, graph closure, bounded decode, color conversion, DXF wrapper, and consumer acceptance owners; no source-confirmed local defect or new top-level subplan is established.

assessment.carrierContract: SAT text, modern DXF binary ACDSDATA, classic DWG entity-stream data, and modern DWG AcDs records are distinct route/version containers. Preserve owner/handle mapping, exact payload boundaries, and diagnostics separately from entity-shell counts.
assessment.peerStatus: ACadSharp #1150 and #1240 remain open proposals, not released behavior; #1150's comments expose a repeated-binary-chunk readback conflict and an explicit preference for schema-driven writer reconstruction.
assessment.safetyContract: Use checked arithmetic before allocation, preserve logical length within actual capacity, avoid stale references across container relocation, reject non-finite unbounded writer inputs, and assert exact terminal payload inclusion only within the touched local owner.
assessment.implementationSpeed: Reuse existing generated selectors, strict targets, compatibility check, and owning CTest. Keep broad suites, peer builds, native applications, kernels, stress cohorts, and sanitizer runs at already-planned composed checkpoints.
assessment.supportEvidence: A parse, entity count, raw-carrier match, or single-application open is not independent solid semantic evidence. J256/J260/J268/J284/J293/J295 remain external and non-promoting.
